name: Minab-Sirik-Kuhmobarak Gas Pipeline

values.OtherEnglishNames: Minab-Sirik-Kuh-e Mobarak Gas Pipeline; Minab-Sirik-Kuh Mubarak Gas Pipeline
values.RouteNotes: Coastal Hormozgan trunkline running Minab -> Sirik -> Kuh-e Mobarak (near Jask) along the eastern Hormozgan coast toward the Sea of Oman; taps off IGAT-7 (P0446). No official GIS located; corridor from endpoint towns only.

researcher_notes: NEW ROW. Coastal Hormozgan gas trunkline, ~200 km total in two 42-in sections that tap off IGAT-7 (P0446) and carry South Pars gas along the eastern Hormozgan coast toward Kuh-e Mobarak / Jask on the Sea of Oman. Section 1 Minab-Sirik (~121 km, 42 in) completed and commissioned in Iranian year 1403 (ended 20 Mar 2025) per IGEDC (Tehran Times, May 2025); gas injection into km 90-120 reported Feb 2025 (IRNA/Mehr, Persian). Section 2 Sirik-Kuhmobarak (~80 km, 42 in) began construction Feb 2023 (pipeline-journal.net; Press TV, Apr 2023), so the full named line to Kuhmobarak is still under construction -> Status=construction (Minab-Sirik leg itself is operating; noted for human de-dup if GEM prefers to split). Sponsor/developer: National Iranian Gas Company via its engineering arm IGEDC (matched existing GEM entity 'National Iranian Gas Co'). CONFIRMED DISTINCT from P2225 Iran-Oman Gas Pipeline (Rudan County -> Sohar port, ~1000 km subsea export leg): different origin (Minab vs Rudan), different character (coastal onshore supply trunk vs cross-Gulf export line); this line FEEDS the Kuh-e Mobarak/Jask export exit but is not the export pipeline itself. Also distinct from P3951 Siri-Mobarak (offshore Siri-island field line) and P0446 IGAT-7 (the trunk it branches from). Confidence: high -- 3 independent verified sources (pipeline-journal.net German trade journal + two Iranian state outlets) plus Persian corroboration (Shana/NIGC, IRNA, Mehr). Capacity not stated in any source -> left blank (no orphan). No official route GIS found; RouteAccuracy=approximate from endpoint towns. ProposalYear left blank (construction underway by 2022-2023; no firm proposal-year citation).
